values.note: Non pull-through sites $35 a night, pull-through full hook-up sites $40, rustic tent sites $15. Booking: a non-refundable $8 reservation fee plus $2 administration per site reserved, and a 2.6% card convenience fee. 'Rates are subject to change annually.'

fees.source: https://emmetcounty.org/experiences/camp_petosega/campsites___cabins.php ('RATES: Rustic sites: $15 per night / Non pull-through sites: $35 per night / Pull-through sites: $40 per night'; 'A non-refundable reservation fee of $8 per reservation, and $2 administration fee for each site reserved'; page (c) 2026), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://emmetcounty.org/experiences/camp_petosega/campsites___cabins.php ('All sites have water and 50 or 30 amp electrical service', 'Sites 86 - 90 are pull-thru with full hook-up'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 90 campsites with water and electric (one, site 35, tent only) and four rustic tent sites. The county's site table gives each site's trailer size: 18-40 ft on the 84 water-and-electric RV sites (86 of 89 RV sites take 23 ft or more), 45 ft on the five pull-through full hook-up sites 86-90.

sites.source: https://emmetcounty.org/experiences/camp_petosega/camp-details-and-map.php ('Camp Site Specs' table: Site #, Type, Power, Trailer Size (ft.)), https://emmetcounty.org/experiences/camp_petosega/campsites___cabins.php ('90 campsites with electricity and water (five of which are pull-through with sewer hook-up), four rustic sites'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'May 1 is the official start of the summer season at Petosega. Water is typically shut off in mid-October and the campground closes for the winter season.' The county's home page also calls it 'a year-round RV park' whose waterlines are drained from mid-October to about May 1; winter rentals are cabins only.

season.source: https://emmetcounty.org/experiences/camp_petosega/campsites___cabins.php and https://emmetcounty.org/experiences/camp_petosega/index.php ('Camp Petosega's camping season runs from early May through Mid-October'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Site-specific online booking through Premier Campground; full payment at booking.

booking.source: https://emmetcounty.org/experiences/camp_petosega/index.php ('Camp Petosega takes reservations 365 days in advance', 'Full payment is required when reserving a site online'; BOOK A CAMPSITE links to online.premiercampground.com), https://emmetcounty.org/experiences/camp_petosega/campsites___cabins.php ('There is a two-night minimum stay and a 14-night maximum stay on all campsite and cabin rentals', 'site-specific'), read 2026-10-22

note: Emmet County park on Pickerel Lake: 300 wooded acres with Berry Creek, miles of trails, a sandy beach and a kayak launch; seven rental cabins. The county advises booking on a computer, as most customers could not finish a reservation on a phone. Tents are allowed on every site; ATVs and UTVs are not. --Claude
summary: Emmet County's pages confirm 90 water/electric sites (5 pull-through full hook-up) + 4 rustic, 30/50 amp, per-site trailer sizes up to 45 ft (stored 40 -> 45), $35-40/night 2026 with an $8 + $2 booking fee, season May 1 to mid-October, Premier Campground booking 365 days out, 2-night minimum and 14-night maximum on every site. Phone 231-347-6536 matches. Note cleaned of hookups, counts, lengths and booking.
